title: Inter- and Intra-Subject Variability in EEG: A Systematic Survey
abstract: arXiv:2602.01019v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) underpins neuroscience, clinical neurophysiology, and brain-computer interfaces (BCIs), yet pronounced inter- and intra-subject variability limits reliability, reproducibility, and translation. This systematic review studies that quantified or modeled EEG variability across resting-state, event-related potentials (ERPs), and task-related/BCI paradigms (including motor imagery and SSVEP) in healthy and clinical cohorts. Across paradigms, inter-subject differences are typically larger than within-subject fluctuations, but both affect inference and model generalization. Stability is feature-dependent: alpha-band measures and individual alpha peak frequency are often relatively reliable, whereas higher-frequency and many connectivity-derived metrics show more heterogeneous reliability; ERP reliability varies by component, with P300 measures frequently showing moderate-to-good stability. translated_title: 脑电图中的被试间与被试内变异性：一项系统性综述
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）是神经科学、临床神经生理学和脑机接口（BCI）的基石，但显著的被试间与被试内变异性限制了其可靠性、可重复性和临床转化。本系统性综述研究了在健康和临床人群中，对静息态、事件相关电位（ERP）以及任务相关/BCI范式（包括运动想象和SSVEP）中脑电变异性的量化与建模。在各范式下，被试间差异通常大于被试内波动，但两者都会影响统计推断和模型泛化能力。稳定性依赖于具体特征：alpha频段指标和个体alpha峰值频率通常相对可靠，而更高频段及许多基于连接性的指标则表现出较为异质的可靠性；ERP的可靠性因成分而异，其中P300相关指标常表现出中等到良好的稳定性。我们总结了主要的……
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了健康与临床人群中脑电被试间与被试内变异性的量化研究，发现被试间差异通常大于被试内波动，且信号稳定性高度依赖于特征类型——alpha频段指标和P300成分相对可靠，而高频及连接性指标的可靠性较为异质。
en_tdlr: This systematic survey quantifies EEG inter- and intra-subject variability across resting-state, ERP, and BCI paradigms, finding that inter-subject differences typically exceed within-subject fluctuations and that stability is feature-dependent, with alpha-band measures and P300 components showing relatively good reliability.
